notes:
## New features
- None in this release.

## Changes
- Faster dense contour calculations for supported ISO source fields, retaining the same acoustic equations and source integration settings.
- Raw contour calculations finish after solving the requested grid. Display interpolation and SmartSmooth reuse that result without automatically calculating more acoustic samples.
- Interpolation now uses an obstacle-conforming triangular field and vector threshold bands, eliminating display-cell stair steps. Gradient samples the same field without image blur.
- Interpolation displays explicitly distinguish presentation detail from verified acoustic accuracy; coarse grids can remain unresolved near sources and screening transitions.

## Bug fixes
- Restored switching between Raw, Interpolated, Gradient and SmartSmooth, with shared presentation caches.
- Corrected contour appearance updates and blending during dragging.
- Preserved the locked report-map extent when resizing sheet preview, reusing the sheet image during resizing.
- Improved contour progress, Results cancellation, and calculation/presentation worker cleanup.
- Corrected an unsupported cylindrical-receiver fallback error.
- macOS build is ad-hoc signed, not Apple notarized.
